description: This file defines a utility module for handling numeric data serialization and deserialization from Uint8Array buffers, including functions for reading and writing various integer and floating-point types with respect to system endianness.

classes.name: NumberUtils
classes.description: A collection of functions that get or set various numeric types and bit widths from a Uint8Array, including endianness handling.

methods.name: getNonnegativeInt32LE
methods.description: Parses a signed int32 at offset; throws an error if the value appears negative.

methods.name: getInt32LE
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 32-bit integer from the source buffer at specified offset.

methods.name: getUint32LE
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 32-bit unsigned integer from the source buffer at specified offset.

methods.name: getUint32BE
methods.description: Reads a big-endian 32-bit unsigned integer from the source buffer at specified offset.

methods.name: getBigInt64LE
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 64-bit signed integer as a bigint from the source buffer at specified offset.

methods.name: getFloat64LE
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit float (double) from the source buffer at specified offset, respecting system endianness.

methods.name: setInt32BE
methods.description: Writes a signed 32-bit integer in big-endian format to the destination buffer.

methods.name: setInt32LE
methods.description: Writes a signed 32-bit integer in little-endian format to the destination buffer.

methods.name: setBigInt64LE
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit bigint in little-endian format to the destination buffer.

methods.name: setFloat64LE
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit float (double) in little-endian format to the destination buffer, respecting system endianness.
